ai_language_tip: Speak polite standard Korean (ko); regional dialects (Busan/Jeju) understand standard Korean; use English only at major Seoul hotels or foreign clinics.
english_ok: rarely — Outside international hotels and Itaewon/Gangnam tourist clinics, local shops rarely handle English phone calls.
politeness: Use polite formal -요/-습니다 speech; open with greeting (안녕하세요) and state calling on behalf of owner (OO님 대신 연락드렸습니다); close with 수고하세요/감사합니다.
name_tip: Full 3-syllable Korean name (e.g. 김철수) is standard everywhere rather than surname alone; spell rare characters by syllable example if misheard.
phone_tip: Mobile 010-1234-5678, Seoul landline 02-1234-5678; read Sino-Korean in 3-4-4 blocks pausing at hyphen (에); confirmations via KakaoTalk (알림톡) or SMS (문자).
time_tip: 12-hour spoken with 오전/오후/저녁 plus Native Korean hours and Sino-Korean minutes (저녁 일곱 시 반); watch 한 시 (1) vs 열한 시 (11).
number_tip: Party size uses Native Korean (한 명, 두 명, 세 명, 네 명); in phone digits, 일 (1) and 이 (2) confuse easily—enunciate clearly.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch peak 11:45–13:00, clinic lunch break (점심시간 13:00–14:00), restaurant break time (브레이크타임 15:00–17:00), and calls after 21:00.
closed_days: Many independent restaurants/salons close Mondays or Tuesdays (정기휴무); clinics close Sundays, public holidays, and Saturday afternoons; major closures on Seollal/Chuseok.
booking_channels: Naver Booking (네이버 예약) and CatchTable (캐치테이블) dominate dining/salons/clinics; Kakao Hairshop for hair; Baemin/Coupang Eats for delivery.
voice_menu: Hospitals, franchises, couriers, banks, telecoms (SKT/KT/LGU+), and government offices (120/110) use ARS keypad menus heavily.
callback_habits: Automated KakaoTalk AlimTalk (알림톡) or SMS confirmations are extremely common; clinics and salons send day-before reminder texts.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 熱門餐廳多改用 CatchTable 現場候位或 Naver 預約訂金制；一般烤肉店、聚餐餐廳與日料仍可電話訂位。
usually_asked: Date and arrival time (몇 월 며칠 몇 시)
Total party size and children/baby chair (성인/아이 몇 분, 아기의자)
Hall table vs private room (홀/룸 여부)
Pre-order menu required for slow dishes like samgyetang/galbi-jjim (메뉴 선주문)
Full name and 010 mobile number (성함과 연락처)

may_come_up.what: Restaurant accepts CatchTable remote waiting or Naver Booking only
Requires pre-ordering main dishes when booking group table
No-kids zone (노키즈존) restriction applies

sensitive_asked.what: Requests bank transfer reservation deposit (예약금 계좌이체) via SMS

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 基層診所（의원）很多採現場掛號免預約，牙科、皮膚科與韓醫院則普遍需預約。
usually_asked: First visit or returning patient (초진/재진 여부)
Symptoms or procedure requested (어떤 증상/스케일링 등)
Patient full name (환자분 성함)
Preferred date, time, and director doctor (원장님 지정)
Mobile number for KakaoTalk reminder

may_come_up.what: Neighborhood clinic takes walk-ins in arrival order only (당일 접수만 가능)
University hospital requires referral slip (진료의뢰서) and ARS/app booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Resident Registration Number (주민등록번호) or full birth date (생년월일)
Demands beauty/dermatology deposit transfer right now

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 韓國個人美甲、美睫工作室常採用100%預約金轉帳制（예약금），電話可能被要求改傳 KakaoTalk 匯款。
usually_asked: Exact service (커트/펌/염색, 젤네일 제거 유무)
Desired date and time
Requested designer or director (디자이너/원장님 지정)
First visit or returning client
Full name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Gel nail shop asks whether existing gel removal (타샵 제거) is needed
Salon directs to Naver Booking or Kakao Hairshop for discount

sensitive_asked.what: Nail/lash studio requires bank transfer deposit within 1 hour to confirm

repair.before_dialing_zh: 三星/LG/現代起亞官方服務中心為全國 ARS 按鍵專線；社區修車廠（카센터）與私修店可直接打。
usually_asked: Vehicle model/plate or appliance/phone model
Symptom or maintenance item (엔진오일, 액정 수리 등)
Preferred visit date and time
Parts stock check needed before visit
Customer name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Official brand service center uses ARS keypad routing
Imported car part needs ordering and separate quote

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone screen lock PIN/pattern over call
Demands advance bank transfer for parts order

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外送多走 배달의민족 / 쿠팡이츠，但電話訂「到店自取（포장 주문）」在炸雞、中華料理與小店仍很普遍。
usually_asked: Takeout pickup vs neighborhood delivery (포장인지 배달인지)
Menu items, spice level, and portion count
Estimated pickup readiness time (보통 15~30분 후 픽업)
Caller phone last 4 digits or full 010 number

may_come_up.what: Offers takeout discount (포장 할인 1,000–2,000 KRW) on pickup
Delivery refused by phone; directs to Baemin/Coupang Eats

sensitive_asked.what: Asks credit card number over phone
Demands immediate bank transfer before cooking

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型百貨與連鎖藥妝（Olive Young等）分店電話常忙線或轉ARS，獨立花店、蛋糕店與書店可電話查貨。
usually_asked: Exact product name, option, or barcode/model
Quantity and branch stock check
Same-day pickup time
Customer name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Same-day hold allowed only for a few hours without payment
Custom lettering cake only accepts KakaoTalk channel + prepayment

sensitive_asked.what: Requires bank transfer (계좌이체) to confirm reservation

change.before_dialing_zh: Naver 預約或 CatchTable 綁定訂金的訂單，通常需由主人在原 App 內自行變更或取消以免扣違約金。
usually_asked: Name and phone last 4 digits (전화번호 뒷자리 네 자리)
Original reservation date and time
New preferred slot or cancellation
Whether booked by phone or Naver/CatchTable

may_come_up.what: App booking with deposit must be canceled in-app by owner
Same-day change forfeits deposit per shop policy

sensitive_asked.what: Asks bank account number for deposit refund or OTP

usually_asked: Specific question (영업시간, 브레이크타임, 웨이팅, 주차 가능 여부, 애견 동반)
Arrival time and party size if asking waitlist
Car size (SUV/sedan) for mechanical parking tower (기계식 주차)
Pet weight and carrier/stroller availability if bringing dog

may_come_up.what: Building has mechanical parking lift (기계식 주차) unsuitable for SUVs
Last order (라스트오더) is 30–60 mins before closing

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 大型飯店訂房專線多有 ARS 選單且需刷卡擔保；度假民宿（펜션）常走官網或 Naver 匯款訂房。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates
Standard vs extra guest count (기준 인원 / 최대 인원)
Room type and bed setup (더블/트윈/온돌)
Guest full name and 010 mobile number

may_come_up.what: Extra person fee (인원 추가비) or BBQ grill fee at pension
Hotel requires credit card guarantee link or OTA booking

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone
Pension requires bank transfer within hours to hold room

activity.before_dialing_zh: 密室逃脫、無人練習室與熱門球場多採線上預付；KTV（노래방）、螢幕高爾夫（스크린골프）常接電話訂房。
usually_asked: Room or bay type (스크린골프 방, 단체룸 등)
Date, start time, and number of games/hours (몇 게임/몇 시간)
Number of players
Name and phone number (or last 4 digits)

may_come_up.what: Screen golf asks 9-hole vs 18-hole and left-handed bay need
Escape room only books via website with deposit

sensitive_asked.what: Requests immediate bank transfer deposit for group room

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 到府服務須提供完整道路名地址與棟/號（동·호수）；大樓常有共同玄關密碼但 AI 絕不可代給。
usually_asked: Service needed and appliance/ac type (벽걸이/시스템 에어컨, 누수, 개문)
Full address with apartment complex, dong, and unit number (동·호수)
Preferred visit date and time window
Parking registration need at apartment guardhouse (방문차량 등록)
Contact name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Call-out inspection fee (출장비) charged if repair declined
Technician calls 30 mins prior so owner can open lobby gate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks apartment lobby password (공동현관 비밀번호) or unit door PIN
Demands advance transfer before visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物美容與寄宿對犬種體重、打結狀況與疫苗非常仔細，部分美容店要求預約金。
usually_asked: Vet care, bath/grooming cut style (목욕/전체미용/위생미용), or hoteling
Breed, weight (kg), age, and neutering status (중성화 여부)
Vaccination status and biting/separation anxiety notes (입질 여부)
Preferred date and time
Guardian name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Tangled fur surcharge (엉킴 추가금) or weight limit over 10kg

sensitive_asked.what: Grooming shop demands no-show deposit transfer (노쇼 방지 예약금)

tracking.before_dialing_zh: CJ大韓通運、로젠等全國客服皆為按鍵 ARS；直撥配送司機（택배기사）010手機或維修店門市才有效。
usually_asked: Waybill number (운송장 번호) or repair receipt number
Recipient name and address (동·호수) for parcel lookup
Item description if waybill missing
Current status or delivery location (문 앞 / 경비실)

may_come_up.what: National courier call center requires keypad ARS input
Courier asks where to leave package (guard office vs door)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks apartment lobby entry password (공동현관 비밀번호)
Asks customs clearance ID (개인통관고유부호)

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、信用卡、網購與水電瓦斯客服全有 ARS 按鍵選單且強制本人手機認證或生日身分證核驗，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: ARS keypad menu selection and resident/birth date keypad entry
Confirmation that caller is account holder in person (본인 확인)
Mobile authentication (본인인증) or SMS OTP
Account or order number

may_come_up.what: ARS demands keypad birth-date entry before connecting agent
Agent refuses third-party inquiry under privacy law

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Resident Registration Number, birth date, card PIN, or SMS OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 日常叫車用 Kakao T；地方鄉鎮コール택시（Call Taxi）、機場大型車接送與租車行可電話預約。
usually_asked: Pickup location (exact building/landmark) and time
Destination or rental period
Passenger and suitcase count
Vehicle type (중형/대형 점보택시/카니발)
Passenger name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Call-taxi fee (콜비 1,000–2,000 KRW) or toll policy
Car rental checks driver age (만 26세 이상) and license tenure

sensitive_asked.what: Requests driver license number or birth date over phone
Demands immediate deposit transfer for jumbo van

property.before_dialing_zh: 韓國不動產（공인중개사）看房前必問租賃方式：全租（전세）或月租（월세）及保證金（보증금）額度。
usually_asked: Deal type: jeonse, wolse, or purchase (전세/월세/매매) and deposit/rent budget
Listing platform/number (네이버 부동산 매물번호) or complex name
Preferred viewing date and time (tenant occupied requires coordination)
Expected move-in date (입주 가능일) and pets/parking need
Visitor name and 010 number

may_come_up.what: Current tenant must approve viewing slot; agent calls back later
Asks whether jeonse loan (전세대출) is needed

sensitive_asked.what: Requests holding deposit (가계약금) before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 區廳、洞住民中心與公家機關多經總機或120轉接，個人證明與學籍限本人；幼兒園（어린이집/유치원）諮詢參觀可打。
usually_asked: Department or inquiry topic (민원 내용 / 입소 상담)
Child birth year/month class (만 몇 세 반) for daycare/kindergarten
Neighborhood dong jurisdiction
Caller name and callback number

may_come_up.what: Daycare enrollment requires registering via i-Sarang (아이사랑) portal
Switchboard uses ARS keypad extension menu

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Resident Registration Number (주민등록번호) or child birth date
